visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a black cap and a beige t-shirt stands in a professional kitchen, gesturing with white-gloved hands while speaking enthusiastically. He has a small elephant logo on his chest. Behind him, another man with black-framed glasses and a grey headband watches closely. The background features metallic kitchenware, shelves with spices, and plants. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the man's gloved hands meticulously removing the tough side muscle from a raw, cream-colored scallop on a silver plate. The lighting is bright and focused on the food. (3) The chef uses a white paper towel to gently pat dry several large scallops on a metal tray, ensuring the surface is moisture-free. The camera angle is slightly overhead to capture the preparation details. (4) Returning to a medium shot, the chef gestures towards a pan off-screen, explaining a technique. His facial expressions are animated, and his body language is open and instructional. (5) A close-up shows the chef sprinkling salt onto the scallops laid out on a paper-lined surface. He then picks one up and places it into a hot cast-iron pan with oil; a small amount of steam/smoke rises upon contact. (6) The chef uses a large metal spoon to flip the scallops, revealing a perfectly browned, caramelized exterior. He adds a large block of yellow butter and several sprigs of green herbs to the pan. (7) He continuously spoons the foaming melted butter over the searing scallops in a basting motion. The scallops appear plump and golden-brown. (8) The final scene shows the finished dish on a white plate with green asparagus and red garnishes. The man with the headband takes a bite from a fork, showing a satisfied and impressed facial expression while the chef looks on confidently. (9) A split-screen graphic appears with two portraits of the chef laughing and the text overlay for the video title.
